verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted, open-source inference engine with no vendor-hosted storage, so a vendor-offered region or data-residency selector is a category error for this product type. Where data lives depends entirely on where the user deploys the engine, and the evidence shows no hosted service with region options.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
